note_text: Asked about PFS data vs standard of care in second-line setting. Wants head-to-head numbers, not just single-arm.
Concerned about grade 3/4 neutropenia rates. Mentioned she has 2 patients currently on a competitor agent with tolerability issues.
Wants clarity on renal-impairment dose adjustment. Prefers concise dosing chart over full label.
Skeptical of open-label trial design in pivotal study. Asked if any blinded confirmatory trial is underway.
Requested MSL follow-up on mechanism of action question re: receptor selectivity. Flagged as high-priority KOL.
